purpose: Hard exclusion registry for recurring hourly Urology question generation and verification. A future row is blocked when it tests the same clinical decision, correct answer, and teaching point, even if surface numbers or wording differ.

blocked_concepts.label: AS suspicious MRI lesion to targeted biopsy
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Active surveillance prostate cancer with suspicious PI-RADS 4/5 MRI lesion after non-MRI-guided diagnostic biopsy -> targeted or confirmatory biopsy.

blocked_concepts.label: High-risk prostate cancer staging imaging
blocked_concepts.block_rule: High-risk localized prostate cancer staging -> bone scan plus pelvic mpMRI or CT.

blocked_concepts.label: Pre-Botox OAB PVR assessment
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Pre-botulinum toxin OAB safety assessment -> post-void residual measurement.

blocked_concepts.label: UTI-associated microhematuria repeat UA
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Microhematuria attributed to UTI after treatment -> repeat urinalysis with microscopy.

blocked_concepts.label: CP/CPPS pelvic floor therapy
blocked_concepts.block_rule: CP/CPPS or male chronic pelvic pain with pelvic floor tenderness/hypertonicity -> pelvic floor-directed physical therapy, myofascial release, or EMG biofeedback.

blocked_concepts.label: Hypercalciuria sodium and normal calcium
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Hypercalciuric calcium stone dietary counseling -> restrict sodium while maintaining normal dietary calcium.

blocked_concepts.label: Hyperuricosuric calcium oxalate allopurinol
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Hyperuricosuric, normocalciuric recurrent calcium oxalate stones after diet changes -> allopurinol.

blocked_concepts.label: Antimuscarinic cognitive risk counseling
blocked_concepts.block_rule: OAB antimuscarinic prescribing or counseling -> discuss dementia or cognitive impairment risk.

blocked_concepts.label: BPH with persistent OAB add-on medication
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Male BPH on alpha blocker with persistent storage/OAB symptoms and acceptable PVR -> add antimuscarinic or beta-3 agonist.

blocked_concepts.label: Intermediate-risk hematuria marker-guided cystoscopy deferral
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Intermediate-risk microhematuria patient declining cystoscopy -> urine cytology or validated urine marker while still performing renal/bladder ultrasound.

blocked_concepts.label: Recurrent UTI self-start therapy
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Recurrent uncomplicated UTI with reliable symptom recognition and culture access -> patient-initiated or self-start therapy while awaiting culture.

blocked_concepts.label: Refractory OAB augmentation or diversion
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Severe refractory idiopathic OAB after behavioral therapy, oral medication, neuromodulation/PTNS, and botulinum toxin -> augmentation cystoplasty or urinary diversion as last-resort option.

blocked_concepts.label: Anticoagulated microhematuria same evaluation
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Patient taking anticoagulant or antiplatelet therapy with confirmed microhematuria -> same risk-based microhematuria evaluation as non-anticoagulated patients.

blocked_concepts.label: CP/CPPS tadalafil phenotype
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Male chronic pelvic pain/CPPS with LUTS or erectile dysfunction -> daily tadalafil as phenotype-directed therapy.

blocked_concepts.label: Recurrent UTI first-line acute therapy
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Symptomatic acute recurrent uncomplicated cystitis -> short-course first-line narrow agent such as nitrofurantoin, TMP-SMX, or fosfomycin rather than default fluoroquinolone.

blocked_concepts.label: Negative PET does not withhold salvage radiation
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Post-prostatectomy biochemical recurrence with negative conventional imaging or PSMA PET/CT while salvage prostate-bed radiation is planned -> proceed with salvage radiation rather than canceling due to negative scan.

blocked_concepts.label: Uric acid stones potassium citrate alkalinization
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Recurrent uric acid stones with persistently acidic urine -> potassium citrate or urine alkalinization as key prevention therapy.

blocked_concepts.label: Stone prevention follow-up 24-hour urine
blocked_concepts.block_rule: After starting dietary or pharmacologic stone prevention -> repeat/follow-up 24-hour urine testing within about 6 months to assess metabolic response.

blocked_concepts.label: D-mannose alone rUTI prophylaxis counseling
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Recurrent uncomplicated UTI patient wants D-mannose alone for prophylaxis -> counsel that D-mannose alone may not be effective for prevention.

blocked_concepts.label: Low/negligible-risk microhematuria repeat UA
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Low/negligible-risk microhematuria with 3-10 RBC/HPF, no smoking/gross hematuria/additional urothelial risk factors -> repeat urinalysis within six months.

blocked_concepts.label: Intermediate-risk NMIBC one-year maintenance BCG
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Intermediate-risk NMIBC patient with complete response after induction BCG and adequate BCG supply -> maintenance BCG for one year as tolerated.

blocked_concepts.label: OAB no rigid step therapy SDM
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Idiopathic OAB patient choosing or combining behavioral, pharmacologic, non-invasive, or minimally invasive therapies -> shared decision-making without a rigid mandatory step-therapy ladder.

blocked_concepts.label: High-risk prostate salvage RT plus ADT
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Post-prostatectomy biochemical recurrence with high-risk features such as Grade Group 4-5, high PSA, or rapid PSA doubling time while receiving salvage prostate-bed radiation -> add ADT.

blocked_concepts.label: High-risk NMIBC three-year maintenance BCG
blocked_concepts.block_rule: High-risk NMIBC complete response after induction BCG with adequate supply -> maintenance BCG for three years as tolerated.

blocked_concepts.label: Residual struvite stones acetohydroxamic acid
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Residual or recurrent struvite stones when surgical options are exhausted or not feasible -> acetohydroxamic acid or urease inhibition.

blocked_concepts.label: Stone pharmacotherapy safety blood testing
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Recurrent stone former receiving pharmacologic prevention such as thiazide/chlorthalidone or potassium citrate -> periodic blood testing to monitor medication safety.

blocked_concepts.label: OAB chronic catheter fallback SDM
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Severe or frail OAB patient after failed/contraindicated/no-longer-desired therapies requesting chronic catheter drainage -> shared decision-making with explicit harm counseling; not first-line or routine escalation.

blocked_concepts.label: Microhematuria renal disease nephrology plus urology
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Microhematuria with proteinuria, dysmorphic red cells, casts, or renal insufficiency -> nephrology referral while still completing risk-based urologic evaluation.

blocked_concepts.label: Persistent recurrent UTI symptoms repeat culture
blocked_concepts.block_rule: Recurrent uncomplicated cystitis symptoms persist after antimicrobial therapy -> repeat urine culture to guide further management before changing prophylaxis.
